fusions.name: Keel on Shingle
fusions.desc: Slams down, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Ballast
fusions.desc: Heaves a ballast stone at the first enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Settled Low
fusions.desc: The damage you take is reduced by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Good Holding Ground
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health holds for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
